title: Run it twice
required_behavior: Split only eligible settled pot per approved room/consenting participants, one deck and two independent remaining runouts; rake once; main/sidepot eligibility; UI prompt
constraints: Requires unanimous applicable consent; never increase expected equity automatically

title: Run it three or more times
required_behavior: N independent runouts with correct deck exhaustion, fractional chips and per-pot awards; variant room choice

title: Side-pot-only run-it-twice
required_behavior: Only consenting eligible sidepot players can split that pot while main pot may run once
dependencies: Run it twice; side pot oracle

title: Single-board NLHE bomb pots
required_behavior: Each dealt-in participant posts configured ante, skip preflop betting, go to flop; pot and rake rule tested

title: Double-board NLHE bomb pots
required_behavior: Two independent boards and split awards, sidepots per eligible shares and odd chips tested
constraints: Not simply two normal hold'em hands

title: Bomb-pot random scheduled frequencies
required_behavior: Opt-in per X hands or probabilistic, transparent trigger/provenance

title: 7-2 game bounty
required_behavior: Optional per-seat side payment trigger, eligibility and virtual reward separate from main pot

title: Stand-up game
required_behavior: Track last player without qualifying win; sidepot virtual prop liability separate

title: NIT game prop
required_behavior: Track players achieving defined qualifying pot/action and pay side virtual game

title: Mississippi straddle
required_behavior: Button/other position straddle changes preflop order correctly

title: Multiple/re-straddles
required_behavior: Allow capped chain of live straddles with correct minraise/order

title: Missed blinds + buying button variants
required_behavior: Post dead/live blinds or wait BB per room; cash wallet exact
constraints: Essential in some realistic seat turnover scenarios

title: Cash time-drop and jackpot drop
required_behavior: Fixed fees vs % pot; no-flop rules and eligible pot reconciliation

title: Match-the-stack buy-ins
required_behavior: Mid-session allowed maximum table stake follows house maximum stack

title: UTG and button antes
required_behavior: Forced payment depends seat and room not tournament default
constraints: Do not invent local room policy

title: Rake-free home games
required_behavior: Dedicated transparent no-rake house profile and ledger
constraints: Existing generic profile may already satisfy

title: Dead button cash options
required_behavior: Versioned cash-button behavior as seats leave

title: Rabbit hunting
required_behavior: Optional post-hand display of undealt community cards; never before hand ends

title: Time bank + action countdown
required_behavior: Per player configurable timing with pause/timeout action legality

title: Bot tanking and snap actions
required_behavior: Noisy timing conditioned on plausible cognitive features, not a direct strength oracle

title: Animated betting chips
required_behavior: Visuals synchronized to authority events, reduced-motion supported

title: Authentic cards/chips/dealer sounds
required_behavior: Optional sound settings, privacy/mute, performance

title: Photorealistic human avatars
required_behavior: Avatar diversity, licensing, performance and accessibility

title: Subtle physical tells
required_behavior: Noisy cues with independent validity testing and reverse tells

title: Chat or table talk bots
required_behavior: Opt-in bounded conversations that do not access hidden cards

title: Bot player backstories
required_behavior: Consistent motivations without using stereotype as probability evidence

title: Opponent identity lifetime across sessions
required_behavior: Selectable long-term memory and player turnover; no cross-user knowledge leak

title: Hundreds of bot personalities
required_behavior: Sample correlated trait vectors from checked distributions; validate distinctness, replay and representative styles

title: Bot personality editor advanced curve lab
required_behavior: Edit conditional pre/postflop action-size surfaces with versioned sandbox

title: Bot fatigue, tilt and confidence changes
required_behavior: Bounded, observable state changes after losses/wins/time; paired-seed verification

title: Unpredictable bluff sequencing
required_behavior: Correlated frequency over sessions without learnable deterministic cycles

title: Dynamic field ecology
required_behavior: Players leave/rebuy/move, table changes and skill mixtures with explicit distributions

title: Simulated table-selection lobby
required_behavior: Choose among modelled tables with accurate sample-limited public information

title: Venue-scenario library
required_behavior: Create/save multiple personally defined room lineups and rake/straddle structures

title: Observed human-hand calibration import
required_behavior: Consent/permission manifest, masks, quality checks, session/person holdouts, provenance

title: Blinded expert human-versus-bot tests
required_behavior: Controlled held-out comparison, report baseline and confidence

title: Independent strength tournament of policies
required_behavior: Bot-vs-bot and exploit agents round robin paired seeds; report variance

title: Counterfactual replay trainer
required_behavior: Branch specific action from same legal state, compare outcome ranges and warnings

title: Post-hand adaptive coach
required_behavior: Explanation uses real legal state/reliable reference, distinguishes estimates/unknown

title: Leak detection dashboard
required_behavior: Track opportunity-weighted repeated mistakes with uncertain effect and cross-population transfer

title: Dedicated preflop range lab
required_behavior: Manual and solver-supported study by position/stacks/rake

title: Flop board-texture drills
required_behavior: Unseen, varied legal hands with full continuation for transfer

title: Turn and river bluff-catching drills
required_behavior: Stratified range/line sampling, honest scoring

title: Multiway pot drills
required_behavior: Proper separate villain ranges, action behind, sidepots

title: 3bet/4bet/squeeze drills
required_behavior: Full hand contexts, legitimate opportunity counting

title: Exploit vs GTO switching lab
required_behavior: Compare constrained verified references and population counterstrategy

title: Spaced repetition curriculum
required_behavior: Novel heldout hand tasks with adaptation and delayed retention

title: Personal milestone chart
required_behavior: Separate game performance from transfer evidence and mastery aspiration

title: Real-world live-session manual log
required_behavior: Optional manually entered actual wins/expenses with separate provenance and uncertainty

title: Session recording and bookmarks
required_behavior: Tag/bookmark pivotal hands without affecting results

title: Hand history importer from user's own play
required_behavior: Legal rights-cleared compatible formats, no private scraped records

title: Hand-history video/graph exports
required_behavior: Privacy-safe storyboards of exposed actions only

title: Statistical confidence/variance simulator
required_behavior: Resample measured session blocks, display estimated intervals and assumptions

title: Study group shared hand replay
required_behavior: Explicit opt-in share links with visibility and deletion

title: Private friend multiplayer
required_behavior: Invitation-controlled real opponents, turns, reconnect and anti-collusion safeguards

title: Tournament friend lobbies
required_behavior: Private STT/MTT for friends with human seats and bot fills

title: Spectator seats
required_behavior: Public info only unless post-hand delayed reveal; fair spectator restrictions

title: Voice or video chat
required_behavior: Separate opt-in permissions and retention policy

title: Leaderboards/achievements
required_behavior: No fabricated skill rank; anti-farming safeguards

title: Cloud account sync
required_behavior: Authorized server-side account and conflict resolution, encrypted secrets

title: Offline installable PWA
required_behavior: Offline solo play, sync/upgrade testing and cache safety
constraints: Can be early if low friction

title: Native iOS/Android app
required_behavior: Native packaging, accessibility and stores/policies

title: Localization/currency profiles
required_behavior: Different language, currency display, locale formatting; chip precision intact

title: High contrast/cognitive accessibility options
required_behavior: Additional theme/profile improvements and reduced motion

title: Modular 4-card PLO
required_behavior: Use exactly 2 hole+3 board, pot-limit raises, Omaha sidepots

title: 5-card PLO
required_behavior: Five hole cards; exactly 2 play, pot-limit bet and deck testing

title: 6-card PLO
required_behavior: Six hole cards, correct 10max deck capacity & combinations

title: Omaha Hi-Lo 8 or better
required_behavior: Qualified low evaluation, quartering, high/low sidepots, odd chips

title: Short Deck 6+ Hold'em
required_behavior: 36-card deck, customized flush/full house ranks and forced ante/button rules

title: Fixed-limit Hold'em
required_behavior: Bet/raise unit per street and raise caps, blinds
constraints: No-limit engine cannot reuse raise cap

title: Pot-limit Hold'em
required_behavior: Pot-sized maximum exact with to-call and prior contributions

title: Pineapple / Crazy Pineapple
required_behavior: Discard at proper phase, legal private/public projections

title: Five-card Draw
required_behavior: Draw phase and replacement-card authority

title: Seven-card Stud / Razz
required_behavior: Bring-in, stud streets and high/low evaluator

title: Mixed game HORSE / rotation
required_behavior: Separate format sub-hands, switch rules between hands, ledger continuous

title: Open-face Chinese Poker
required_behavior: Distinct legal placement/scoring, fantasyland optional

title: Tournament satellites
required_behavior: Fixed seat/ticket payouts rather than normal cash prizes

title: Tournament deal-making/ICM chop
required_behavior: Consensual prize restructuring without chip modification, explicit ledger
constraints: Must not masquerade as optimal deal

title: Mystery bounty tournaments
required_behavior: Hidden reward draw conditional on actual elimination with liability tracking

title: Progressive KO and bounty builders
required_behavior: Split cash/progressive bounty and exact relevant-pot ties
constraints: May be R3.1 if user prefers

title: Multi-flight and Day 2 events
required_behavior: Separate phase advancement and field/state migration

title: Rebuy/add-on tournaments
required_behavior: Rebuy during permitted windows with prize/fee accounting

title: Hyper turbo / spin-and-go
required_behavior: Fast blinds, field formats, spinner prize source fairness

title: Shootout tournaments
required_behavior: Advancement by table wins with correctly separated rounds

title: Tournament ICM study
required_behavior: Bubble factor, risk premium, payout equity model with scenario validity
constraints: Do not claim heuristic solver true EV

title: Responsible-use settings
required_behavior: Opt-in session breaks, reminders, practice-only clarity
